steps.content: [Background - Core Research Institute]
The attack ceases abruptly. The Aurum Secretum shackles—linking Synex to the Cocoon—jerk taut, pinning her in place.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huh?
At first, Hella only stares, bewildered. Then, a sound from above. Her gaze snaps upward just as an image flickers to life before her, projected from the observation room overhead.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hmph, so the old guy lurking behind the scenes finally shows himself. You ready to surrender, or what?

steps.speaker: Director Hermis
steps.content: No. Sacrificing a valuable Corpus vessel to stop a mere intrusion would be inefficient. For the current situation, we have a more optimal solution.

steps.speaker: Director Hermis
steps.content: Think of this as a "proposal."

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: A... proposal?

steps.speaker: Director Hermis
steps.content: Precisely. You've all thoroughly proven your worth. Fraser has no interest in the backgrounds of talented individuals, only in rewarding them properly. We can offer far better compensation than DisCity ever could.

steps.speaker: Director Hermis
steps.content: Rather than fight a losing battle... why not join the side bound for victory? What do you say?
Hella and Horo exchange glances. Half a second later, Hella sighs, brushes the dust off herself, and straightens up.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Heh. And here I thought you were gonna say something important. Turns out it's the same old crap.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: "You're so talented," "Join our side," "We'll appreciate you more"—blah, blah, blah—
She raises a single defiant finger high, pointing it toward the ceiling.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't ******* underestimate us! How many times d'you think I've heard this same tired bullshit? Your scam's weak as hell. Go practice for another 800 years before you even try to trick someone!
Horo remains silent, simply standing beside Hella, her position already crystal clear.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: ————!!

The battle resumes. Synex's attacks grow frenzied, each strike more erratic than the last. As Hella barely evades them, she catches the glint of Aurum Secretum snaking across Synex's skin. And beneath its glow, Synex's flesh cracks, peels away, as if her very body is unraveling.
From her neck, a chain of Aurum Secretum extends like an umbilical cord, tethering her to the monstrous Cocoon at the area's heart.
The chain hums in sync with the Cocoon's pulse, amplifying Synex's power, but at a cost. With every surge, she became less human.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Synex! You bastard, snap out of it already! Argh!
Her words are useless. Another onslaught comes, relentless.

Clang— Horo's massive axe intercepts the blow, but even she staggers under the force. The Legion's defense is barely holding Synex back, yet there's no opening, no chance to counterattack. She's a storm of violence, unyielding, unstoppable.
And at this rate, Synex won't last. Her body will shatter before the battle even ends.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Damn it...
[Brief Scene Change: The director watches a video feed in a room]
The Legion's defensive perimeter continues to collapse. The man observes it all with a cold scoff—the outcome is inevitable. There's no point in watching any further.
Just as he turns to leave, an eerie disturbance prickles his senses.

steps.speaker: Director Hermis
steps.content: This is...

With a guttural snarl, Synex shatters through the Legion's last defenses. She raises her arm for the killing strike, only for the fighters at her flanks to surge forward in perfect unison, locking her down in a brutal, coordinated counterattack.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Hella! Now!!!
A metallic glint cuts through the monster's blurred vision. The dagger, temporarily sealed by Aurum Secretum, flares to life in Hella's grip as Mania erupts, devouring everything in its wake.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: ————?!!!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey... Synex, you bastard. We've got way too much unfinished business for you to just run away like this...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wake up, you hear me?! Get up and pay what you owe meeeee!!
BOOM—!!!!

The burst consumes nearly the entire testing site in a wave of searing energy. Thick smoke billows in every direction, obscuring the director's view of the chaos below. His frown deepens with frustration.
He steps forward, straining for a clearer look—
BANG!!! Razor-sharp claws slam against the observation room's energy barrier, sending a shower of sparks erupting through the haze. A figure emerges from the smoke.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Hahahaha! I've been dying to do this for ages!
The monster's restraints lie in ruins, severed by the blade. She is free.

steps.speaker: Director Hermis
steps.content: Fool. The Institute gave you more than enough freedom. You just lacked the sense to appreciate it.

steps.speaker: Director Hermis
steps.content: Do you really think you can survive outside? Cut off from your Aurum Secretum supply, you'll die.
Another brutal strike. The barrier shudders, its surface alive with violent arcs of electricity, buckling under the force.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: You call freedom on a leash freedom? Don't make me laugh!

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: You're all so arrogant, only staring at what's in front of your faces, at your little chains and seals, convinced they could cage monsters...
Suddenly, Synex releases her grip. A slow, deliberate smile curls across her lips as she plunges from above. The glow of the Cocoon pulses below, waiting to embrace her fall.
The director's expression finally changes.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: So you never understood. What I—what we've always needed was never that damn thing...

steps.speaker: Refugee Child
steps.content: Thani, Thani! Quick, look over there—

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: ...What is that?!
BOOM—!!!!
Countless bombs ignite, their thunderous blasts ripping through the institute's halls. The grand main facility erupts in gouts of flame, resembling, oddly enough, a celebration.

steps.speaker: Refugee Child
steps.content: Fireworks! They're setting off fireworks!
Every entrance and exit lies blown open. Freed from restraint, the alchemic beasts surge forth in a frenzied tide, scattering in all directions.

steps.speaker: Institute Guard
steps.content: How the hell are all the alchemic beasts loose?! Fall back! Someone stop them— AAGH!
The guard's words die in his throat as the swarm engulfs him.

steps.speaker: Sandra
steps.content: Cough, cough...
Amid the chaos, the woman sneaks her way toward the research institute's entrance. She doesn't know what drives her—stubborn hope, perhaps, or something deeper.
BOOM. The stone pillars above collapse in a deafening crash. Sandra is too close, too slow. She braces for impact, squeezing her eyes shut... But the pain never comes.
A tiny alchemic beast has thrown itself between her and the rubble, its fragile body straining to form a shield. It trembles, writhing, its voice a whisper of half-formed words.

steps.speaker: Little Yuri
steps.content: I'm... back...
No language can contain their longing. At last, the mother pulls her child into her arms.
[Black Screen]

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Cages are for livestock, not monsters.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: We don't want to die, but neither do we want to live like this, rotting in a cage, forever trapped...
[CG - Devour]

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Ha... Haha... Hahahahaha!
Synex tears a deep gash into the Cocoon, her teeth sinking in and rending its shell to fragments.

Shards of the Apostle slip through her fingers as the thing inside is forced into a grotesque, premature birth, its first sound a hateful wail shattering the air. And as the newborn horror writhes, the other monster laughs, wild and delighted.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Life's too short to play by the rules. And since no one asked my opinion... why not tear them all to shreds?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Come on, let's make this chaos legendary!
